claims.quote: Barnet welcomed the appearance of the atomic engine with the zest of masculine youth in all fresh machinery
claims.description: Atomic-powered engines become practical and are used in vehicles such as aircraft.

claims.quote: These new helicopters, we found,’ he notes, ‘had abolished all the danger and strain of sudden drops to which the old-time aeroplanes were liable
claims.description: Atomic-powered helicopters make personal air travel safe, used for holiday flights across Europe and Africa.

claims.quote: he aeroplaned to Italy and then had a pedestrian tour from Genoa to Rome, crossed in the air to Greece and Egypt
claims.description: Private aeroplane travel is routine among prosperous young people for tourism.

claims.quote: Barnet saw the last days of the coal-steam engines upon the English railways and the gradual cleansing of the London atmosphere as the smoke-creating sea-coal fires gave place to electric heating.
claims.description: Coal-steam railway engines are retired and coal fires replaced by electric heating, clearing London's air.

claims.quote: London, under the Visible Smoke Law, by which any production of visible smoke with or without excuse was punishable by a fine, had already ceased to be the sombre smoke-darkened city of the Victorian time

claims.quote: The insanitary horse and the plebeian bicycle had been banished from the roadway, which was now of a resilient, glass-like surface, spotlessly clean
claims.description: Horses and bicycles are banned from city roads, replaced by clean glass-like road surfaces for motor traffic.

claims.quote: the Rows, that ran along the front of the houses at the level of the first story, and, being joined by frequent bridges, gave the newer parts of London a curiously Venetian appearance.
claims.description: London gains elevated pedestrian walkways at first-floor level joined by bridges, with pedestrians barred from crossing roadways.

claims.quote: the police had power to challenge and demand the Labour Card of any indigent-looking person, and if the record failed to show he was in employment, dismiss him to the traffic pavement below.

claims.quote: the men had struck that day against the use of an atomic riveter that would have doubled the individual efficiency and halved the number of steel workers.

claims.quote: They were a sample of that great mass of unskilled cheap labour which the now still cheaper mechanical powers had superseded for evermore. They were being ‘scrapped’—as horses had been ‘scrapped.’

claims.quote: He belonged until the financial *débâcle* of 1956 to the class of fairly prosperous people
